steps.text: Welcome to your first shift! Drag anywhere to drive your pompwagen.
A supplier offer! Your first delivery is FREE — accept it!
The truck is at the dock. Stand on the UNLOAD pad to take a pallet.
Drive to the rack and store the pallet. Repeat for all {pallets} pallets.
A customer order! {store} needs {needed} pallets — you have {stock} ✔. Accept!
Load their truck: take pallets from the rack to the LOAD pad.
+€{profit} profit! Leftover stock waits for the next customer. You're the boss now — keep the trucks moving!
